526:t_1:89.en:
$$レド$$
「Even if this is training, they could die if something goes wrong.」

526:t_1:90.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「...That is what the two who gave up after two hours are saying.」

526:t_1:91.en:
$$レド$$
「You refused to join in from the start.」

526:t_1:92.en:
$$アルト$$
「Besides, you're crazy to go along with that!」

526:t_1:93.en:
$$ルカ$$
「At this rate, we'll spend every day training until the refits are finished.」

526:t_1:94.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Major $$カリーニン$$ really impresses me. He divided up supplies and hid them on isolated Pacific islands in case of an emergency.」

526:t_1:95.en:
$$カレン$$
「That's true. $$テッサ$$ said losing the major was a huge blow to both their fighting strength and morale.」

526:t_1:96.en:
$$レド$$
「Do these refits mean $$宗介$$ and the others' machines will be upgraded?」

526:t_1:97.en:
$$ルカ$$
「As for $$ゼロ$$ and the others' KMFs, and $$マオ$$, $$クルツ$$, and $$クルーゾー$$'s ASes...」

526:t_1:98.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「I get upgrading the ASes with the supplies here, but can we do anything for the KMFs too?」

526:t_1:99.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ says $$ラクシャータ$$ and the others also helped $$ミスリル$$ during the $$時獄戦役$$.」

526:t_1:100.en:
$$ルカ$$
「They drew up upgrade plans for $c's KMFs then, too. Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ is personally directing the refits.」

526:t_1:101.en:
$$カレン$$
(Thank you, $$テッサ$$... You remembered our promise from the $$時獄戦役$$.)

526:t_1:102.en:
$$アルト$$
「Will $$マオ$$ and the others' ASes get $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$s?」

526:t_1:103.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Unfortunately, that's impossible. $$ミスリル$$'s only working $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ was the one installed in the $$アーバレスト$$.」

526:t_1:104.en:
$$レド$$
「So the current $$アーバレスト$$ is an empty shell without either its $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ or $$アル$$.」

526:t_1:105.en:
$$アルト$$
「Even so, $$宗介$$ is ready to fight.」

526:t_1:106.en:
$$カレン$$
「If he keeps pursuing $$アマルガム$$... $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$, he'll definitely see $$かなめ$$ again...」

526:t_1:107.en:
$$カレン$$
「I guess $$宗介$$ believes that, and that's why he's training himself all over again.」

526:t_1:108.en:
$$レド$$
「He's doing it for someone precious to him...」

526:t_1:109.en:
$$宗介$$
「You don't have to join me, $n. This isn't regular training. It's my own personal routine.」

526:t_1:110.en:
$n
「You don't want me seeing how exhausted you look?」

526:t_1:111.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Hey, $n! $$宗介$$! Quit chatting, or that demon $$クルーゾー$$ will cruise on over!」

526:t_1:112.en:
$n
「Haha... We must be really at our limit...」

526:t_1:113.en:
$$宗介$$
「We must be... We're laughing at such a terrible joke.」

526:t_1:114.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「That's because your muscles and nerves are rejoicing.」

526:t_1:116.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Training the body trains the spirit, and a stronger spirit makes the body respond. Repeating that makes a warrior stronger.」

526:t_1:117.en:
$n
「You're saying exactly what my dad used to say...」

526:t_1:118.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「$l... I hear your father served in the $$ブラックベレー$$...」

526:t_1:119.en:
$n
「Yes... Whenever he got worked up, he'd rattle off that filthy four-letter F-word his superior always used.」

526:t_1:120.en:
$$ティティ$$
「What is that filthy F-word?」

526:t_1:122.en:
$n
「Dad said his instructor drilled that spirit into him at a field training camp when he was in the military.」

526:t_1:123.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Did your father ever say something like this, by any chance?」

526:t_1:124.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「War isn't so easy that sweating and rolling in mud will win it...」

526:t_1:125.en:
$n
「But what can a man who's never been covered in sweat, mud, blood, or tears do...? That's the rest, right?」

526:t_1:126.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「I believe we've hit the jackpot.」

526:t_1:127.en:
$$宗介$$
「Could $n's father's instructor have been 《$$あの中佐$$》...?」

526:t_1:129.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Then I'll train you strictly according to the lieutenant colonel's theories!」

526:t_1:132.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Run, run, run! Are you dragging your asses because you're blond bimbos who love chasing men?!」

526:t_1:134.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Is your motivation all talk?! Are you rip-off artists who can only give lip service?!」

526:t_1:136.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Then put some spirit into it! Move, move, fucking move!!」

526:t_1:138.en:
$n
(Let's keep at it, $$宗介$$... so we can rescue $$千鳥$$, too...!)

526:t_2:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「...You should enjoy it too. Enjoy the moment that pathetic machine goes up in flames.」

526:t_2:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
「There was a guy in the next class who always stared at girls with this slimy, lecherous look. Apparently he did stalker stuff too.」

526:t_2:7.en:
$$かなめ$$
「That creepy boy and you... If I had to date one of you, which do you think I'd choose?」

526:t_2:9.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm asking you. Which do you think?」

526:t_2:10.en:
$$レナード$$
「Stop asking such tasteless questions.」

526:t_2:12.en:
$$レナード$$
「Enough with the vulgar comparisons. Listen to my...」

526:t_2:13.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm not going to do whatever you say. You're going to hear the conclusion I reached.」

526:t_2:15.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Prepare to be shocked. I seriously spent a whole day thinking about this question...」

526:t_2:16.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I honestly can't decide. In the end, the only difference between you and that creepy boy is whether you're handsome or ugly.」

526:t_2:17.en:
$$レナード$$
「Would you give it a rest? I don't have that much time to spare.」

526:t_2:18.en:
$$かなめ$$
「That's it. It's that smug smile plastered on your face.」

526:t_2:19.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You lock me in a cage, treat me like a doll, take everything from me, break my spirit, then look at me with that smile...」

526:t_2:20.en:
$$かなめ$$
「That smile is just as creepy as that creepy boy.」

526:t_2:22.en:
$$かなめ$$
「When $$宗介$$ first showed up in front of me, he was a pretty creepy guy...」

526:t_2:23.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But he was different from you. He... never wore a stupid grin...」

526:t_2:24.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Whatever happened, he was always fighting something with an honest look in his eyes.」

526:t_2:26.en:
$$レナード$$
「As I said in $$東京$$, I'm always serious too.」

526:t_2:27.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You mean on that rooftop in the rain? That didn't explain anything.」

526:t_2:28.en:
$$かなめ$$
「In the end, don't you really have no idea what loving someone means? That's why $$テッサ$$ turned her back on you, too.」

526:t_2:30.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You're sarcastic and all show. You never open up to anyone. You only see women as objects.」

526:t_2:31.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Is it that old story, by any chance? Your parents didn't love you enough?」
